market_reason: Treasury yields at multiyear highs, oil elevated amid Iran war tensions, and reports of record market leverage after the Situational Awareness collapse raise tail risk, but markets are rallying on soft inflation data and nothing is crisis-grade.
market_headlines: Troubles at Situational Awareness Point to Record Stock Market Leverage - The New York Times
U.S. Treasury Yields Hit Multiyear Highs on Economic Data, Fed Rate-Boost Expectations - WSJ

summary: Stocks rallied on mild inflation data, but the 10-year yield is near 25-year highs and oil is rising on Middle East and Iran tensions. The Situational Awareness collapse and reports of record leverage are worth watching, though none of it is a fresh shock large enough to justify a veto.
